title: worker_deduplicate_successful_tasks: a failed read of the result backend ends a redelivered task without running it; it is acked and stays PENDING when the backend is down
where: not in the tracker yet; no upstream thread found (searched worker_deduplicate_successful_tasks, BackendGetMetaError, dedup backend unavailable; closest celery PR 10960 and 10159, other paths). The check has caught only BackendGetMetaError since it came in (celery PR 6722, 2021), and that is raised only under result_backend_always_retry
observed: 768e476 with kombu 445027e, real prefork workers -c 1 on Redis (broker 6379, backend in its own container on 6391), acks_late, dedup on, visibility_timeout 2 s. Worker A is SIGKILLed 1 s into a 3 s run (injected); the message is restored and worker B takes it. down (the backend container stopped while B takes it, started 8 s later): 2 of 2 runs the task never ran again, the message was acked, the state stayed PENDING; B logged "Exception raised outside body: network:ConnectionError" and "Pool callback raised exception". readonce (the first read in B raises redis ConnectionError, the backend is up): 3 of 3 FAILURE stored, never ran. With result_backend_always_retry: the task ran and ended SUCCESS (downretry 2 of 2, readonceretry 3 of 3). Without dedup the same redelivery simply runs the task.
